road: Real factory costs

Pull prices from Alibaba, 1688 and Made-in-China by spec, not the cheapest snippet. Auto-calculate landed cost: freight by box size, tariff by product code. Finalists get quotes from 3 suppliers (drafted, you approve).
The dash cam miss: $42 assumed, about $80 real.
Sales from every channel
Add TikTok Shop sold counts (EchoTik, Kalodata or FastMoss), Amazon sales history (Keepa), Walmart and Etsy.
Today it only sees Amazon.
Sales trend, not a snapshot
Save every weekly scan so it sees rising vs fading products, plus Google Trends.
Catches winners early and avoids fads.
Virality measured, not judged
Count TikTok views, creators posting, and how long ads keep running (Foreplay) per product.
Today the '3-second wow' score is my judgment.
Competition and moat
Top-brand share, review counts, number of sellers, price wars.
Avoids markets one brand owns.
Clean data
Real package weight and size for every product, never a 1 lb default.
Bulky items get the right shipping cost.
Patent and safety checks
Google Patents, USPTO trademarks, CPSC recalls and FCC IDs checked automatically.
Stops copycat and recall risks early.
Learns from our own launches
After every test, compare what it predicted with what happened (sales, cost per customer, returns) and re-weight.
The only way to reach a true 10: it has to be right for us.
